LanguageData.VME_FleshcraftedArm.label: spare arm
LanguageData.VME_FleshcraftedArm.description: A spare arm, hacked off sumfin' what didn't need it as much as we do. Still a bit wriggly. Stick it on someone what's lost theirs, or eat it. Might go all festery on anyone who ain't into fleshcraftin'.
